Medical Practice's physicians and nurse practitioners serve patients across multiple skilled nursing facilities. Every day, someone on the clinical team must review each patient's chart to

— checking for changes in vital signs, lab abnormalities, nursing note keywords, admission dates, payor requirements, and regulatory timelines. This manual process consumes significant staff time that could be redirected to direct patient care, introduces human error risk (particularly around regulatory compliance deadlines), and lacks any systematic mechanism to ensure that clinically significant changes are caught and acted upon
The system supports practice-defined compliance windows aligned with CMS guidance

requires that physicians see new skilled nursing admissions within 3 days and maintain at least a 30-day visit frequency. Nurse practitioners may perform interim visits but do not substitute for the physician's required regulatory encounter. A missed 30-day physician visit is not simply an administrative oversight — it is a compliance violation with potential survey, billing, and liability consequences.
